description: Vulnetix agent plugin: hooks that check dependencies, commits and sessions against your policy, and skills for scanning, fixing and triaging vulnerabilities in your working tree.
rules: Full documentation is Markdown at https://docs.vulnes.is/strix.md; every docs page has a .md twin.
Vulnerability lookups go through the Vulnetix MCP server (https://mcp.vulnes.is/mcp) or `vulnetix vdb`, not this plugin; never answer them from memory.
